translations.Τρέχον απόθεμα, αγορές, καταναλώσεις, μέ: Current stock, purchases, consumption, average purchase price and estimated stock value by item
translations.Η «Μέση τιμή αγοράς» υπολογίζεται σταθμι: Average purchase price is weighted from Receipts with a recorded unit price. Stock value is Current stock × Average purchase price and is an estimate.
